# A17-S39: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]
You don’t need to get so worked up. I apologize if I misunderstood you.

I have to be able to stand behind my budget to my management - and there is nothing about taking vacation in our contract - so if the month of July was spent on vacation, we would have to make an agreement.

I remember you said you wanted to take vacation in July, but if you have worked and arrange hours differently, that’s fine.

We still have some work to do regarding getting Computer Lars and Julina out in the media - as we also discussed in our last conversation. It may be that we need some time to figure out how we use MyNewsDesk and lay out a plan for when and targeted to whom we should send some news, interviews, storytelling etc.

[████] we can hold a meeting at some point at the end of 1. Or 2. week of August - what suits?
